implementation: src/profile.py; exact bytes hashed in results.json

representations.DSSE: Section 4.1, exact B and selected signature -> internal analysis
representations.DIGEST_ONLY: Section 5.1 typed JSON reference, no candidate receipt supplied
representations.DIGEST_RESOLVED: Section 5.1 typed JSON reference plus matching candidate supplied

selector.unit: whole B (empty pointer); exact B SHA-256 and explicit cardinality one
selector.multiple_records: reject unless exactly one candidate matches; do not deduplicate attempts

digest_rules.receipt_citation: SHA-256 over extracted B, as-transmitted, no reserialization
digest_rules.local_binding: SHA-256 over source/output exact bytes plus explicitly named local JSON encoding of the tuple

claim_scope: Limited observable distinctions in these cases, not whole-requirement or format conformance

labels.PRESERVED: The stated bounded distinction/negative behavior survived in observed output. Does not establish truth or full conformance.
labels.QUALIFIED_LOSS: A known claim-relevant distinction from the test input is unavailable after the specified hop; the harness reports the limit.
labels.UNESTABLISHED: Available source/verification inputs do not establish the requested distinction or stronger claim. Never a measured failure.
labels.NOT_APPLICABLE: The native scenario cannot occur in valid SER, or no reliance event was supplied; refusal/absence checked, not counted as support.

unknown_policy: Do not infer execution, completeness, criteria chronology, custody, authority, identity or zero uncertainty. Unknown schema/member/version rejects semantic acceptance; retain opaque digest evidence only.
numeric_policy: Exact decimal strings and bounded exact integer n; no float conversions. One decimal ROUND_HALF_UP only as an explicit local presentation derivation; no comparison against derived value attributed to source.
crypto_policy: Ed25519/COSE/SCITT verification NOT_EVALUATED. Published crypto expectations are not local results. Two later-auth probes use a public test-only HMAC-SHA256 key and are not signatures or SER verification.

requirements.title: Source and Mapping Identity
requirements.derived_obligation: Identify source snapshots, selectors, interpretation rules, converter and profile; bind material mapping information to the actual source and output. Distinguish digest byte selections.

requirements.title: Unambiguous Result Selection
requirements.derived_obligation: Select a unique result and its task/metric/attempt/population context under a declared syntax. Do not resolve ambiguity by choosing a favorable record.

requirements.title: Execution, Observation, and Assessment
requirements.derived_obligation: Keep execution, observation and criterion assessment distinct. Omitted criterion information is not explicit absence; missing/error/invalid/non-execution is neither measured success nor failure.

requirements.title: Values, Units, and Numerical Transformations
requirements.derived_obligation: Preserve exact numeric meaning, units and uncertainty when supplied. Mark rounding and other transformations; a rounded display cannot establish the original threshold comparison.

requirements.title: Criteria, New Judgments, and Chronology
requirements.derived_obligation: Attribute source criteria and later judgments separately. Chronology needs supporting evidence; timestamps and digest commitments alone do not establish pre-run criteria.

requirements.title: Coverage, Aggregation, and Attempts
requirements.derived_obligation: Keep population accounting, missing portions, retries and aggregation rules. Supplied records do not establish the full set of actual attempts.

requirements.title: Qualified Identity and Evaluation Context
requirements.derived_obligation: Distinguish declared names and commitments from verified executed identities and context. Carry the strength, scope and verification basis of evidence.

requirements.title: Evidence Availability and Digest Knowledge
requirements.derived_obligation: Distinguish actor-scoped availability from reported, recomputed or unavailable digests. Do not fabricate bytes, custody, reasons or existence.

requirements.title: Loss, Conflict, and Multi-Hop Preservation
requirements.derived_obligation: Track copied assertions, derivations, conflicts and losses across hops. Later authentication cannot recover discarded qualifications or certify a complete loss inventory.

requirements.title: Typed Verification and Bounded Consumption
requirements.derived_obligation: Type verification by actor/procedure/inputs and keep structural, digest, signature and substantive checks distinct. Bound processing and keep unsupported claims unestablished.

requirements.title: Separate Reliance and Downstream Decisions
requirements.derived_obligation: Do not invent a governance/control event from export. Actual reliance records need separate attribution, policy, subjects and inputs; they alone establish neither authority nor effect.

requirements.title: Versioned Mappings and Verification Evidence
requirements.derived_obligation: Version supported semantics and unknown-value policy; report concrete negative/ambiguous fixtures and observed behavior. Same-author testing is not independent interoperability.
